scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,BROWSER "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "node scripts/open-dev.mjs"
scripts.compile: npm run compile:backend && npm run compile:frontend
scripts.check: npm run check:scripts && npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend && npm run compile
scripts.check:backend: npm --prefix backend run lint:check && npm --prefix backend run test -- --runInBand
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && node --test frontend/tests/team-quadrant.test.mjs frontend/tests/employee-color.test.mjs
